scope: Fresh producer-free replay of fixed two-qubit validation correctness draws
driver_source:
"""Replay complete integration controls without importing any producer SDK."""

import argparse
import collections
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HARNESS = Path("/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121")
PIN = "9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144"
assert (
    subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=HARNESS, text=True, timeout=20
    ).strip()
    == PIN
)
assert not subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=HARNESS, timeout=20
)
sys.path.insert(0, str(HARNESS / "src"))
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import WIDTHS, FAMILIES, TOPOLOGIES, fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("--inspected", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--fresh", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
bundle = Bundle(HARNESS / "docs/implementation")
report = {
    "scope": "Fresh producer-free replay of fixed two-qubit validation correctness draws",
    "source_commit": PIN,
    "driver_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "driver_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "draws": {},
}
canonical = lambda value: json.dumps(
    value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False
)
for draw, path in (("inspected", args.inspected), ("fresh", args.fresh)):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    data = json.loads(raw)
    assert data["completed"] and data["admission_passed"] and data["mode"] == "quality"
    manifest = data["manifest"]
    assert manifest["source_commit"] == PIN
    expected = {
        (f"{w:02d}/{f}/{t}", flow, variant, 11)
        for w, f, t, flow, variant in itertools.product(
            WIDTHS,
            FAMILIES,
            TOPOLOGIES,
            tuple(manifest["configurations"]),
            ("baseline", "candidate"),
        )
    }
    observed = collections.Counter(
        (r["case"], r["workflow"], r["variant"], r["seed"]) for r in data["rows"]
    )
    assert set(observed) == expected and set(observed.values()) == {1}
    inputs = {r["case"]: r for r in data["inputs"]}
    maximum = 0
    for row in data["rows"]:
        width, family, topology = row["case"].split("/")
        width = int(width)
        source = fixture(width, family, topology, manifest["input_nonce"])
        assert (
            hashlib.sha256(canonical(source).encode()).hexdigest()
            == inputs[row["case"]]["fixture_sha256"]
        )
        encoded = data["payloads"][row["payload_sha256"]]
        assert hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode()).hexdigest() == row["payload_sha256"]
        payload = json.loads(encoded)
        payload["compile_wall_seconds"] = row["compile_wall_seconds"]
        metrics = routing(
            payload,
            source,
            None,
            bundle.cases["ROUTE-GRID-08" if width == 8 else f"ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}"],
            0,
        )
        assert row["status"] == "accepted" and row["metrics"] == metrics
        assert payload["final_layout"] == list(range(width))
        maximum = max(maximum, metrics["max_semantic_error"])
    assert not {"flagquantum", "qiskit", "cirq"}.intersection(sys.modules)
    report["draws"][draw] = {
        "original_report_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        "observations": len(data["rows"]),
        "maximum_semantic_error": maximum,
        "full_operator_rows": sum(
            r["metrics"]["verification"] == "full-operator" for r in data["rows"]
        ),
        "three_probe_rows": sum(
            r["metrics"]["verification"] == "three-probes-only" for r in data["rows"]
        ),
    }
    print("replayed", draw, len(data["rows"]), maximum, flush=True)
report["producer_sdks_imported"] = False
with args.output.open("x") as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
